class antagonism. Prometheus is a ghost without the reality of the automatic workshop.

The proletarian synthesis
As long as the proletariat is undeveloped, theoreticians invent utopian systems.
But as history moves forward and the material conditions for emancipation
mature, science ceases to be doctrinaire.
'They no longer need to seek science in their minds; they have
only to take note of what is happening before their eyes and to
become its mouthpiece... science has become revolutionary.'
